title: backlog.py new bug refuses a repro whose program check refuses
goal: Retrospective of SP-qxcj7fgy: ST-7avb5uo6's worker filed BG-77i2lwmr with a grep repro; new accepted it, the worker's backlog.py check ran before the filing, and land stopped at the sync gate (backlog.py check errors=1, and three test_land_e2e tests that copy the backlog) until the orchestrator rewrote the repro on the branch. new bug, set --repro and set --check refuse a program that bl_intake.check_program_refusal refuses, with exit 2 and nothing written, so a worker's filed bug never fails the landing gate.

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,"new","bug","--title","b","--severity","S3","--goal","g","--repro","grep -q zzzzqqqq _tools/backlog.py","--repro-reason","the defect is a docstring line"],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==2 and os.listdir(t+"/_backlog")==[] else 1)
